tools.name: get_multi_context
tools.description: Get context for multiple identifiers in a single request. Useful for batch operations. A cache object means the answer comes from a saved index not yet re-checked; a miss is then not conclusive.

identifiers.description: List of identifiers to get context for

type.description: Optional type filter applied to every identifier

depth.description: How many relationship levels to traverse

includeTests.description: Whether to include classified test evidence

exact.description: Exact matching; omit for exact-first fallback

maxRelationships.description: Maximum entries returned per relationship list

maxCallSites.description: Maximum source locations per aggregated relationship

maxTestFiles.description: Maximum test files returned; zero is count-only

maxTestMethods.description: Maximum test methods per file; zero is count-only

sourceFile.description: Repository-relative or absolute source file filter

relation.description: Comma-separated relation kinds to filter uses/usedBy (CALLS, MOCK_CALLS, REFERENCES, IMPLEMENTS, INHERITS, EXTENDS, IMPORTS, USES); compact view only

view.description: Response shape; compact is the default

includeExternal.description: Whether to include library symbols, which name matches and uses otherwise leave out

tools.name: get_context
tools.description: Get comprehensive context for a code identifier. Returns relationships, dependencies, tests, and metrics. A cache object means the answer comes from a saved index not yet re-checked; a miss is then not conclusive.

identifier.description: Canonical returned identifier, symbol name, or file path

type.description: Filter by type (Class, Method, Interface, Property, etc.)

depth.description: How many relationship levels to traverse (0-10)

includeContent.description: Whether to include file content snippets

exact.description: Exact matching; omit for exact-first with substring fallback

includeRelated.description: Whether to include loosely related symbols

maxRelationships.description: Maximum entries returned per relationship list

maxCallSites.description: Maximum source locations returned per aggregated relationship; zero is count-only

maxTestFiles.description: Maximum test files returned; zero is count-only

maxTestMethods.description: Maximum test methods returned per file; zero is count-only

expandAmbiguous.description: Expand bounded ambiguous matches instead of returning summaries

containingType.description: Filter members by their containing type

namespace.description: Filter by exact namespace or module

sourceFile.description: Filter by repository-relative or absolute source file

relation.description: Comma-separated relation kinds to filter uses/usedBy (CALLS, MOCK_CALLS, REFERENCES, IMPLEMENTS, INHERITS, EXTENDS, IMPORTS, USES); compact view only

view.description: Response shape; compact is the default

includeExternal.description: Whether to include library symbols, which name matches and uses otherwise leave out

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Get comprehensive system health and debugging information

tools.name: get_path
tools.description: Find how one symbol reaches another: a shortest chain of recorded calls, references, inheritance and imports, with dispatch from an interface or base member to its implementations. When there is none, explanation says why, naming your own filters if they hid one. Static evidence, not runtime behavior.

from.description: Where the path starts: canonical identifier, exact or qualified name, or file path (no substring match)

to.description: Where the path ends, as from

relation.description: Comma-separated relation kinds a hop may follow (CALLS, MOCK_CALLS, REFERENCES, IMPLEMENTS, INHERITS, EXTENDS, IMPORTS, USES); dispatch to implementations is always followed

includeTests.description: Whether the path may pass through symbols in test files

tools.name: get_affected
tools.description: List what could break if a symbol or file changes: everything that uses it, transitively, nearest first, including callers through the interface or base member it implements. Nothing is added for merely sitting nearby. Test-file dependents are counted and listed with includeTests. Static evidence, not runtime behavior.

identifier.description: The symbol or file that would change: canonical identifier, exact or qualified name, or file path (no substring match)

relation.description: Comma-separated relation kinds that carry impact (CALLS, MOCK_CALLS, REFERENCES, IMPLEMENTS, INHERITS, EXTENDS, IMPORTS, USES); without it implementations of a changed declaration are affected too

includeTests.description: Whether affected symbols in test files are listed (they are always counted)

tools.name: get_hubs
tools.description: List the load-bearing symbols: those with the most distinct direct dependents, optionally within a directory or of one type. Tests and library symbols are left out unless asked for.

relation.description: Comma-separated relation kinds counted (CALLS, MOCK_CALLS, REFERENCES, IMPLEMENTS, INHERITS, EXTENDS, IMPORTS, USES)

type.description: Only symbols of this type (Class, Method, Interface, ...)

within.description: Only symbols under this repository-relative directory or file

includeTests.description: Whether symbols in test files are ranked and their uses counted
